rotation: Same three sessions fixed to Mon / Wed / Fri so load progression stays readable week to week.
note: Week of 09-08 went 2 of 3, and the miss was Monday. So Monday is the shortest day in the program now: four exercises, roughly 30 minutes. Supersets are gone this week because pairing meant holding two machines and felt awkward. Straight sets, short rest.

sessions.title: Quads & Press
sessions.focus: Knee-dominant lower body, one horizontal press, one horizontal pull. Deliberately the shortest day of the week, because Monday is the one that keeps slipping.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Stop before your hips curl off the pad. That roll is lumbar flexion, the one thing to avoid.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Stop one or two reps short. Dumbbells you can bail on, so push these honestly.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Torso stays still. Pull with the back, not by rocking the whole body.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Low back pinned to the floor the whole set. This is the anti-lordosis work, not filler.

sessions.title: Hinge & Overhead
sessions.focus: Loaded hip extension plus vertical pressing and pulling. The only day with real posterior-chain work, and the hip thrust doubles as lordosis work.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Stop at a straight line from knee to shoulder. Ribs down, do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.cue: Pick one load you can finish all three sets with. Last week opened at 50 and fell to 30. Start near 35.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: 100 for 10 at Hard last week. Same weight, chase 12 before the load moves.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Handle at the sternum, press straight out, nothing rotates. Stand far enough from the stack that it genuinely pulls you sideways.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows locked to your ribs. 35 sat right at 10 reps, so add reps this week, not weight.

sessions.title: Single-leg & Back
sessions.focus: One leg at a time for hip stability, incline pressing, and rear-shoulder work to balance Monday's pressing volume.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cue: Torso upright, front shin near vertical. Hold 60 and make all three sets clean before adding.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Bench at 30 degrees. 60 for 10 across at Hard earns the jump to 65.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.cue: One arm at a time, single handle. Let the shoulder blade travel forward, then pull. Write the number down this week.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Rope at eye height, pull to the eyebrows, elbows high. If you lean back to move it, it is too heavy. Start at 20.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top. No bouncing. Record the load this time.

optional_addins.title: Hips & Posture
optional_addins.focus: Direct work on the lordosis: lengthen the hip flexors, get the glutes doing their job, brace without arching.
optional_addins.when: Any off day. 12 minutes. The one that actually moves the lordosis.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute to tuck the pelvis. That tuck is the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Stop at a straight line. Do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Hips stay square. Slow beats far.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Resist the twist. Nothing rotates.

optional_addins.title: Arms & Shoulders
optional_addins.focus: Low-stakes volume for arms and side delts. Nothing here taxes recovery, so skip it guilt-free.
optional_addins.when: Saturday flex day. 20 minutes if you have the energy, skip it if you do not.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows at your sides. No swinging from the hips.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.cue: Neutral grip the whole way. Hits the brachialis.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell extension
exercises.cue: Ribs down, elbows in. Do not arch to get under the weight.
